messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: final social plan for Launch Week (Redwood Serving Patterns webinar). Need X thread (4 tweets), LinkedIn single-image post + carousel variant, 20s teaser, and an inbound routing spec. Can we finalize assets + schedule today?

Ravi Desai: I can own copy and UTM suffixes. Proposed UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=serving_patterns_lw. Will post X on Wed 11am PT and LinkedIn on Thu 10am PT.

Sam Torres: Ill produce teaser (20s) and 3 card carousel. Need final slide copy and speaker headshots. What CTA for X thread? Sign-up or watch-live?

Maya Chen: Prefer sign-up CTA for X, watch-live CTA for LI. Sam, using existing speaker headshots in Drive (folder: /Marketing/ServingPatterns).

Clara V: Routing: HubSpot form -> list 'LW_ServingPatterns'. If user registers + attends -> assign to SDR queue with priority=high. Ill create HS workflow and SFDC mapping. Also want to tag leads with 'source_social' and 'variant_a/b'.

Ravi Desai: Draft thread (compact):
Tweet1: "Serving LLMs at scale is about patterns, not hacks. Join our engineers for 30min of practical playbooks.
Tweet2: "Well cover caching, batching, and safe rollouts.
Tweet3: "Live demo: routing & graceful degradation.
Tweet4: "Register: [short.link] + utm params"

Sam Torres: Uploaded 20s teaser clip + carousel mockups to Drive (link). Exported a 1080x1080 MP4 + Twitter native sizes.

deploy-bot: Draft scheduled for review: X thread draft queued by @Ravi Desai. Review deadline in 6h.

Maya Chen: Quick A/B plan for tweet 2: A=technical ("caching + batching"), B=outcome ("40% cost reduction"). We'll run variant labels for routing tags.

Clara V: HS workflow checklist I'll apply: 1) new form -> add to list, 2) send confirmation email + calendar invite, 3) attended -> change lead status + create SDR task, 4) add tags (source_social, variant). Sharing export shortly.

Ravi Desai: Made minor edits: tightened headlines, added inline speaker handles. Pasting final copy in doc now.

Sam Torres: Carousel variant B includes speaker one-liner + logo lockup. Made small contrast tweak.

Maya Chen: Owners: Copy/AB: Ravi. Assets: Sam. Scheduling: Maya. Routing/workflow: Clara. Please react when youre set.

Sam Torres: :thumbsup:

Ravi Desai: :thumbsup:

Clara V: :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Great, Ill confirm schedule in marketing-calendar and drop final links in #marketing-ops.
